description: Files every backend must reject atomically. Row numbers are 1-based and include the header row. `contains` lists substrings that must appear in the reported reason, chosen so that both implementations satisfy them; where the two backends word a reason differently, only the row is asserted.

files.case: a column is renamed, so no row can be trusted
the columns are reordered, which the contract does not allow
a header with no data rows is an operator mistake, not an empty day
a ledger timestamp without a timezone cannot be compared to another clock
a negative gross amount is a sign convention the contract rejects
an unknown state such as PENDING must not be silently treated as settled
a row cut short by a broken export is reported, never partially imported
the same trade ID appears twice with different amounts
every defect in the file is reported at once and nothing is imported
a direction outside B/S/BUY/SELL cannot be guessed
a spreadsheet exported a grouped number such as 15,250.00
the file carries a byte that is not valid UTF-8
files.note: The file is rejected at decode time, so only rejection is asserted here.
